title: Conference: Melancholic Historicity – Lost Pasts and Past Losses
speaker: Organised by Katherina Kinzel and Robert Vinkesteijn (UU)
location: Thu: Drift 13-003 · Fri: Drift 23-104 · Sat: UB Binnenstad, zaal 0.21
description: Three-day conference on a 'melancholic' approach to historicity, oriented around loss, destruction and defeat (Benjamin, Hegel, Arendt, Burckhardt, Nancy and others). Thursday: loss, mourning, melancholia and nostalgia. Friday: processing loss in culture, art and ecology. Saturday (morning only): between defeat and hope. Co-funded by the Descartes Centre. To register, e-mail r.w.vinkesteijn@uu.nl.
